I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm OPS-5140, so it stays marked as unverified.

- **Channel:** Nothing in #central-team mentions a gate kiosk outage or that ticket number. The only similar name is "Quarendon Freightways," a driver's company that came up in a July 2025 scanner issue for a different customer. I didn't treat it as the same company.

I asked that someone on the account or in support confirm the number from the ticket system and post it in the channel before anyone uses it.
